name: Melt
body:
School evocation [cold, water]; Level druid 1, shaman 1

Casting Time 1 standard action

Components V, S, M (a pinch of rock salt)

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)

Target one 5-ft. cube of ice or 10-ft. cube of snow/level, or one cold creature/level

Duration instantaneous

Saving Throw none or Fortitude half, see text; Spell Resistance see text

This spell melts all snow and ice in the area turning into an equal volume of water and then spreads. Snow decreases to one-tenth of its volume in water. This does not prevent the water from refreezing.

If used on a cold creature or a magical ice object like the wall of ice, this spell deals 2 damage per caster level (maximum 10 damage). A successful Fortitude save halves this damage, if applicable.
